# Horizon Pulse

> Pay-per-call APIs for AI agents, paid in USDC on Base with x402 v2: web search, page fetch and extract, screenshots, PDF to text, an HTTP proxy, and crypto market data. No signup or API key.

Contact: horizonpulse.co@proton.me

Base URL: https://horizonpulse.dev (the only host; do not pay any other host)

## Payment (x402 v2)

- Unpaid request → HTTP 402 with `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header (base64 JSON, x402 v2); the body carries the same challenge as JSON
- Network: Base mainnet CAIP-2 `eip155:8453`
- Asset: Base USDC `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`
- payTo: `0x5b32c973596078a967562ca652761404f19be0e9`
- Facilitator: Coinbase CDP `https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402`
- Retry the same request with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` (v2). On success the settlement receipt is in the `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header. Optional: `OPTIONS` returns discovery + `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` without charging.

| GET | /api/x402-check?url=https://…[&method=POST][&body=<json>] | $0.01 | 10000 | Audit any x402 endpoint: 402 validity, v1/v2, decoded price, payTo EOA vs contract, discovery hints (never pays; optional JSON body for POST probes, auto POST retry on 405) |

## Input bounds

- `/api/portfolio`: `address` required, `0x` + 40 hex.
- `/api/fetch`: `url` required (http/https). Caps 200KB, 8s, 3 redirects.
- `/api/http`: `url` required; `method` GET|POST|HEAD|PUT|PATCH|DELETE; `headers` JSON object of strings (GET: as a JSON string); `body` on POST/PUT/PATCH only. Caps 384KB response, 64KB body, 12s, 3 redirects.
- `/api/extract`: `url` (GET) or `url`/`html` (POST JSON); `fields` up to 20 CSS selectors. Caps 200KB HTML, 8s.
- `/api/screenshot`: `url` required; `width` 320-1920, `height` 240-2000, `fullPage=true` (clipped at 4000px), `format` png|jpeg, `delayMs` 0-3000. 25s budget.
- `/api/search`: `q` required, max 300 chars; `n` 1-5 (default 3).
- `/api/pdf`: `url` required, max 10MB; `pages` 1-50 (default 50). Max 100K chars.
- `/api/x402-check`: `url` required; `method` GET|POST; `body` JSON (POST probes only).

## Billing and errors

- You pay only for a successful response. The payment is verified first and settled after the handler succeeds.
- Errors return JSON `{ "ok": false, "error": "...", "code": "..." }` and are not charged: 400 bad input, 413 too large, 415 wrong content type, 422 nothing usable (e.g. `no_fields_matched`, `no_text_layer`), 404 no search results, 502 upstream failure, 503 search provider unavailable, 504 timeout.
- Exceptions: `/api/http` returns upstream 4xx/5xx as data (charged), and `/api/x402-check` bills any HTTP answer from the target.
- Response schemas and examples for every operation are in `/openapi.json`; free samples are at `/api/demo/<route>`.

## Which route to call

- Need a web page as clean text for an LLM: `/api/fetch`
- Need to research a question on the web, with sources: `/api/search?q=…&n=3`
- Need the text of a PDF (paper, filing, manual, invoice): `/api/pdf?url=…`
- Need to call any public HTTP endpoint (custom method/headers/body): `/api/http`
- Need structured fields from a page (title, links, headings, JSON-LD), or specific values by CSS selector: `/api/extract` with `fields`
- Need to see what a page looks like (visual check, OG preview, UI verification): `/api/screenshot?url=…`
- Need to check an x402 endpoint before paying it, or audit your own: `/api/x402-check?url=…`
- Need a quick crypto market read: `/api/pulse` (spot + momentum), `/api/signals` (indicators + funding)
- Need DeFi yields, gas timing, or perp funding: `/api/yield`, `/api/gas`, `/api/funding`
- Need a wallet risk snapshot: `/api/portfolio?address=0x…`

## Free samples (no payment)

`GET /api/demo/<route>` runs the real handler on a fixed input and returns `demo: true`. Use it to check the response shape before paying. Inputs cannot be changed.

- /api/demo/fetch, /api/demo/http, /api/demo/extract, /api/demo/x402-check, /api/demo/screenshot, /api/demo/search, /api/demo/pdf
- /api/demo/pulse, /api/demo/signals, /api/demo/yield, /api/demo/gas, /api/demo/funding, /api/demo/portfolio

## Free (not paid)

- GET `/` — landing (live paid catalog + agent how-to)
- GET `/status` — live USDC `balanceOf` on payTo (not revenue) + catalog
- GET `/llms.txt` — this file
- GET `/openapi.json` — OpenAPI 3.1 for every paid operation: typed parameters and bodies, 200/400/402 schemas and examples, and per-operation `x-payment-info` (price, asset, network, payTo)
- GET `/.well-known/x402` — machine-readable x402 resource list

## Agent how-to (short)

1. Call routes on `https://horizonpulse.dev` only.
2. Call a paid route with no payment → 402 + `PAYMENT-REQUIRED`.
3. Confirm network `eip155:8453`, Base USDC, atomic `amount`, and `payTo`.
4. Sign and retry with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`.
5. On success, response body is live JSON for that route.

## Honesty

- Real upstream data only (Coinbase Exchange, CoinGecko, OKX, DefiLlama, public RPCs). No stubbed prices.
- `/api/fetch` returns best-effort cleaned text from the requested public URL; private/localhost blocked; size/time capped.
- `/api/http` is a raw universal proxy (filtered headers, text|base64 body); same SSRF guards; priced $0.01 for volume.
- `/api/extract` returns best-effort structured fields from a public URL or provided HTML; private/localhost blocked; size/time capped; priced $0.015. Optional `fields` (up to 20 CSS selectors, deterministic, no AI): each unmatched field is null with a `fieldErrors` entry; if no field matches, 422 `no_fields_matched` and no charge. Selector work has a hard 2s budget; pages nested deeper than 256 levels are refused for fields.
- `/api/x402-check` sends one unpaid request and never pays or signs; it reports the challenge as served. Any HTTP answer from the target (including 5xx) is a billed report; bad input, blocked hosts, DNS/connection failures and timeouts return 400/502/504 and are not charged. Priced $0.01.
- `/api/screenshot` renders in a fresh headless Chromium with no cookies; every HTTP(S) sub-request is SSRF-checked, the top-level host is pinned to its checked IP, and WebSocket/WebTransport/WebRTC are disabled in page scripts; billed only when an image is returned. Priced $0.02.
- `/api/search` sends the query to a third-party search API (Serper, Google results) and fetches each result through the same SSRF-safe pipeline as `/api/fetch`; pages that fail carry their own error. Billed when at least one result is returned; bad input, zero results, or a search-provider failure return 400/404/503 and are not charged. Priced $0.03.
- `/api/pdf` downloads the file through the same SSRF checks (every redirect hop, 10MB cap; larger files are rejected, not truncated) and reads the PDF text layer with pdf.js; no OCR. Billed only when text is returned; bad input, blocked hosts, non-PDFs, oversize, encrypted or corrupt files, image-only PDFs (`no_text_layer`), download failures, and a 10s parse budget running out before any text (`parse_timeout`; partial text is returned as truncated) return 400/413/415/422/502/504 and are not charged. Priced $0.02.
- Do not invent routes, prices, or Bazaar index status.
